reply.thought: I need to verify that the refunds reported by Alpha Co match the refunds recorded in the system before processing any payouts. I will first list the refunds to compare them with the reported values.

The refunds in the system match the refunds reported by Alpha Co. Now I need to identify the customers involved in these orders to calculate their net balances. I will list the orders to find the customer IDs associated with order IDs 220, 222, and 223.

The refunds match. The customers involved in the refunded orders are 'acme' (orders 220 and 223) and 'cobalt' (order 222). I need to calculate the net balance for each unique customer. I will start with 'acme'.
I have the net balance for 'acme'. Now I need to get the net balance for 'cobalt', the other customer with refunded orders.
I have the net balances for 'acme' and 'cobalt'. Now I need to record the payouts for each customer. I will start with 'acme'.
The payout for 'acme' has been recorded successfully. Now I will record the payout for 'cobalt'.
Both payouts have been recorded successfully. The task is complete.
